trigger.what: A deployment recreates two services. The one with the higher address is started first, so the two trade addresses.

A.location: the deployment step that recreated containers without restarting the gateway (runtime action, no file changed)

label_note: This world needs an event after the change: two services are removed and started again in the other order. The control world W-010C runs the same event with the original 10-second setting. The symptom is temporary by nature: it ends when the cached addresses expire or the gateway restarts.
knowledge_A: The gateway keeps service addresses for 5 minutes, so that a short DNS outage does not break it.
knowledge_B: The gateway follows a new container address within 10 seconds.
observed_symptom: Run of 2026-11-21 02:05. The two services traded addresses (home-timeline-service 172.20.0.19 -> .17, user-timeline-service .17 -> .19). Probes changed: P7 and B1. Both are home-feed reads through the gateway and both return 500 'Get home-timeline failure: Invalid method name: ReadHomeTimeline': the request reached the container that now holds the old address, which is user-timeline-service. The failure is partial: two other home-feed reads in the same run passed (A1, T1), and every user-timeline read passed. The control W-010C, with the same event and the original 10-second setting, showed no change. Clean again after revert. Not explained yet: why only some requests fail (a possible reason is that each gateway worker keeps its own address cache; not checked).
